title: Runtime Role x Endpoint Authorization Matrix
purpose: Operation-level actor, scope and assignment metadata. Every protected Spring MVC handler is keyed independently by ControllerSimpleName#JavaMethodName; live HTTP method and resolved route are expanded from RequestMappingHandlerMapping at test runtime.

actorProfiles.PLATFORM_SUPER_ADMIN: Persisted users row plus all PLATFORM_* grants in platform_user_permissions; no tenant membership.
actorProfiles.PLATFORM_SUPPORT: Persisted global user with PLATFORM_SUPPORT_ACCESS only in platform_user_permissions; no tenant membership; may grant/revoke bounded audited support access but cannot administer tenants or vendor data.
actorProfiles.VENDOR_ADMIN: Persisted vendor employee with tenant-owned Vendor Admin role assigned through employee_role_assignments; effective permissions are the active role-permission union and all data queries remain tenant-scoped.
actorProfiles.CUSTOM_VENDOR_ROLE: Persisted employee membership with a tenant-owned custom role containing only PRODUCT_VIEW; no hardcoded role-name authorization.
actorProfiles.POS_CASHIER: Persisted employee role with POS operation grants and employee_register_assignments for the exact tenant branch/register.
actorProfiles.ACCOUNTANT: Persisted vendor employee with tenant-owned Accountant role grants and explicit active register assignment for branch-scoped reports; cannot receive stock, operate cashier sales or cross into customer APIs.
actorProfiles.CUSTOMER: Persisted global user and customer_profiles row; no vendor membership.
actorProfiles.VIEW_ONLY: Persisted vendor role containing only *_VIEW grants; must not authorize a mutation.
actorProfiles.NO_PERMISSION: Persisted active vendor employee membership with no active employee_role_assignments.
actorProfiles.DISABLED: Persisted disabled user and disabled employee membership; authentication must fail.
actorProfiles.WRONG_TENANT: Persisted active employee and complete role in another tenant.
actorProfiles.WRONG_CUSTOMER: Persisted global customer identity unrelated to the target customer resource.
actorProfiles.WRONG_ASSIGNMENT: Persisted active vendor employee with required operation permissions, assigned to a different register in the same branch; forged target register/session identifiers must not grant access.
actorProfiles.CUSTOMER_VENDOR_DUAL_IDENTITY: One persisted global user with both customer_profiles and an active employee membership. Ambiguous login must return 409; a selected Customer context has CUSTOMER only and no tenant; a selected Vendor context has only persisted vendor-role grants and a server-resolved tenant plus composite membership key.
actorProfiles.PLATFORM_VENDOR_OVERLAP: Rejected identity configuration: a platform_user_permissions identity must not have a customer profile or employee membership. Vendor commercial work must use a separate global authentication identity; no Platform/Vendor context switch.

MarketplaceEnquiryController#submit.assignment: Explicit sharing consent; optional authenticated customer link only when contact email matches authenticated global identity; product ID constrained to published product under selected tenant; per-vendor requester rate limit

ProductImageController#listPublic.assignment: Active vendor slug plus published product; image metadata is same tenant/product scoped

ProductImageController#readPublic.assignment: Active vendor slug plus published product; image metadata is same tenant/product/id scoped

ProductImageController#upload.assignment: ACTIVE_VENDOR_MEMBERSHIP_AND_PRODUCT_UPDATE; content signature/size validation; object key includes tenant/product

SolarPackageController#create.assignment: ACTIVE_VENDOR_MEMBERSHIP_AND_PRODUCT_CREATE_AND_PRICE_UPDATE; all components locked within same tenant

SolarPackageController#publicList.assignment: Active vendor slug resolves tenant; only published packages and tenant-owned component snapshots

SolarPackageController#update.assignment: ACTIVE_VENDOR_MEMBERSHIP_AND_PRODUCT_UPDATE; expected version; PRICE_UPDATE for pricing; PRODUCT_ARCHIVE for unpublish

VendorCustomerCrmController#createNote.assignment: Active Vendor actor; CRM_NOTE_CREATE; server-derived actor/tenant; verified relationship; required reason

VendorCustomerCrmController#customers.assignment: Active Vendor actor; CUSTOMER_RELATION_VIEW; tenant-scoped tenant_customers query

VendorCustomerCrmController#notes.assignment: Active Vendor actor; CRM_NOTE_VIEW; tenant/customer scoped relationship and note queries

VendorCustomerCrmController#updateNote.assignment: Active Vendor actor; CRM_NOTE_UPDATE; tenant/customer/note scoped lookup; expected version; required reason

VendorLeadController#assign.assignment: LEAD_ASSIGN; target active same-tenant employee with LEAD_VIEW; optimistic version; mandatory reason; audit

VendorLeadController#assignees.assignment: LEAD_ASSIGN required; tenant-scoped active employees only; audited read

VendorLeadController#list.assignment: Active vendor membership and LEAD_VIEW; tenant-derived query; inbox read audit event

VendorLeadController#updateStatus.assignment: LEAD_UPDATE assigned-to-self or LEAD_ASSIGN tenant manager; optimistic version; mandatory reason; audit

VendorSiteSurveyController#create.assignment: LEAD_UPDATE; lead is locked by authenticated tenant ID; employees may schedule only for assigned leads; managers with LEAD_ASSIGN may schedule for tenant leads

VendorSiteSurveyController#list.assignment: LEAD_VIEW; tenant managers with LEAD_ASSIGN may view all tenant surveys; employees without LEAD_ASSIGN see only their assigned surveys

VendorSiteSurveyController#update.assignment: LEAD_UPDATE; survey is locked by authenticated tenant ID; employees may update only assigned surveys; expectedVersion rejects stale writes and terminal states cannot change

VendorTenantProfileController#read.assignment: TENANT_PROFILE_VIEW; tenant ID derived from authenticated membership

VendorTenantProfileController#update.assignment: TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATE; tenant row lock; expected version; append-only field-name audit

QuotationController#vendorList.assignment: LEAD_VIEW; LEAD_ASSIGN widens visibility only within the authenticated tenant

QuotationController#create.assignment: LEAD_UPDATE and assigned lead or LEAD_ASSIGN; enquiry must be linked to the global customer identity

QuotationController#revise.assignment: LEAD_UPDATE and assigned lead or LEAD_ASSIGN; only OPEN quotations may be revised

QuotationController#customerList.assignment: CustomerAccess.resolve binds all rows to the authenticated global customer ID

QuotationController#customerGet.assignment: Repository query is keyed by authenticated customer ID and quotation ID; foreign quotations return 404

QuotationController#decide.assignment: Only the customer owner can accept/reject the latest SENT unexpired revision; conversion is transactional and idempotent

QuotationController#vendorCatalogue.assignment: LEAD_VIEW; server-derived tenant comes from active vendor membership; only the tenant published catalogue projection is returned

VendorPaymentAccountController#list.assignment: TENANT_PROFILE_VIEW; tenant comes only from active vendor membership; provider references are masked

VendorPaymentAccountController#submit.assignment: TENANT_PROFILE_UPDATE; body cannot set verification state; account submission/resubmission is audited and remains pending until provider verification

QuotationController#vendorDocument.assignment: LEAD_VIEW; document data comes only from the tenant-owned quotation and saved revision; vendor must own or be assigned to the source lead

QuotationController#customerDocument.assignment: CustomerAccess resolves the global customer identity; repository lookup requires customer ID and quotation ID; document access is audited

InstallationController#eligibleOrders.assignment: INSTALLATION_ASSIGN; all order reads include tenant_id, ONLINE, PAID, customer_id and no existing tenant/order installation

InstallationController#vendorList.assignment: INSTALLATION_VIEW; INSTALLATION_ASSIGN widens list only inside authenticated tenant

InstallationController#vendorGet.assignment: INSTALLATION_VIEW; tenant-qualified job read; assignedTo must match actor unless INSTALLATION_ASSIGN

InstallationController#create.assignment: INSTALLATION_ASSIGN; paid online order locked within tenant; only one installation per tenant/order; assignee must be enabled tenant employee with active INSTALLATION_VIEW grant

InstallationController#assign.assignment: INSTALLATION_ASSIGN; tenant-qualified job row lock and optimistic version; assigned employee must hold active INSTALLATION_VIEW

InstallationController#updateStatus.assignment: INSTALLATION_UPDATE; only assigned engineer or INSTALLATION_ASSIGN actor; completion additionally requires INSTALLATION_COMMISSION; transitions are optimistic and audited

InstallationController#customerList.assignment: OrderHistoryService resolves the authenticated global customer into paid-online order references; each installation read is scoped by the verified tenant/order composite key.

InstallationController#customerGet.assignment: OrderHistoryService resolves the authenticated global customer into paid-online order references; job detail and events use the verified tenant/order composite key; foreign IDs return 404.

InstallationController#eligibleEngineers.assignment: INSTALLATION_ASSIGN; only enabled employees with an active persisted tenant role grant are returned

ServiceRequestController#eligibleVendorO.assignment: SERVICE_CREATE; order query is tenant-qualified and returns only paid orders with a customer identity

ServiceRequestController#eligibleAssigne.assignment: SERVICE_ASSIGN; only enabled employees with an active persisted tenant SERVICE_VIEW role grant are returned

ServiceRequestController#vendorList.assignment: SERVICE_VIEW; SERVICE_ASSIGN widens listing only within the authenticated tenant; other employees see only cases assigned to their username

ServiceRequestController#vendorGet.assignment: SERVICE_VIEW; tenant-qualified request read; assignedTo must match actor unless SERVICE_ASSIGN

ServiceRequestController#vendorCreate.assignment: SERVICE_CREATE; order locked inside authenticated tenant; installation link is resolved using the same tenant and order; event and outbox append in the same transaction

ServiceRequestController#assign.assignment: SERVICE_ASSIGN; tenant-qualified request row lock and optimistic version; assigned employee must hold active SERVICE_VIEW

ServiceRequestController#updateStatus.assignment: SERVICE_UPDATE for forward progress or SERVICE_RESOLVE for resolution/closure; tenant-qualified row lock, optimistic version, transition validation, immutable event and outbox

ServiceRequestController#eligibleCustome.assignment: OrderHistoryService resolves authenticated global customer into paid-online order references; no client-supplied tenant is accepted

ServiceRequestController#customerList.assignment: Each request query is scoped to the verified tenant/order composite references returned for the authenticated customer

ServiceRequestController#customerGet.assignment: Request detail and customer-visible events use only verified tenant/order references; foreign request IDs return 404

ServiceRequestController#customerCreate.assignment: Authenticated customer actor must match Principal; order must appear in the customer's paid-online order references; tenant derived server-side; no vendor/customer cross-context
